237779.name: Furesh Elevated Folding Pet Bath Tub & Wash Station, Gray
237779.description: Keep your furry friend clean without breaking your back — thanks to Furesh Elevated Folding Pet Bath Tub & Wash Station! Ideal for cats and small- to medium-sized dogs, it raises your little darling up to an ergonomic height, so washing him is much easier than if he was in the tub. And when bath time is done, you can drain the water into your sink, shower or bath with a flexible built-in drain hose. Plus, this innovative accessory weighs just 11 pounds and folds down to a width of just eight inches, so it can be stored in any out-of-the-way spot! Now that cleaning your pet is this easy and convenient, you may even find time to do it more frequently.

306301.name: Wondurdog Dog Washing & Paw Rinse Outdoor Garden Hose Nozzle Attachment
306301.description: Wondurdog Outdoor Garden Hose Nozzle Attachment; Get a groomer-quality bath in the comfort of your own home with the Wondurdog Outdoor Garden Hose Nozzle Attachment. This kit easily attaches to your garden faucet for stress-free bathing, and the splash shield sprayer-brush keeps the water off of you and out of your dog's ears and eyes. The rubber teeth make it suitable for both long and short hair. Innovative rubber splash shield keeps you dry. Included pressure control valve. Massaging brush helps make bath time less stressful. Ergonomic and easy to use. Metal garden hose connector for a sturdy, leak-free connection.

370809.name: Wondurdog Deluxe Indoor Dog & Cat Washing Shower Kit
370809.description: Give your best buddy a groomer-quality bath in the comfort of your home with a Wondurdog Deluxe Indoor Dog & Cat Washing Shower Kit. This unique kit is designed to help you give your fur-iend a bath indoors without the mess. The special splash shield shower brush head keeps the water where you need it—away from your buddy's ears and eyes. Water pressure control lets you increase or decrease water pressure with a slide of the valve, which means a deeper and easier clean. The brush’s rubber teeth make it paw-fect for brushing and massaging both long, and short-haired fur-iends. Finally, the kit includes an 8-foot stainless-steel hose that can be stored on the suction cup holder or on a shower diverter, with a hook for the shower brush head. It’ll feel like a day at the spaw, in your own bathroom!

650214.name: Water & Woods Braided Rope Slip Dog Leash, Green
650214.description: Water & Woods Braided Rope Slip Dog Leash, Green; Your pup will be the bark of the town wearing the fetching Water & Woods Braided Rope Slip Dog Leash! This leash-collar combo is made from soft, flexible braided rope for added comfort. It also features leather slides that allow you to adjust to find the right fit for your paw-some pup. It's paw-fect for crate transfers, field trials, or everyday walks! Made from soft, durable braided rope material! Features a two-in-one collar and leash combination. Features leather slides that allow for sizing adjustments. Can be used for crate transfers, field trials, or everyday walks. Available in multiple colors!

2075838.name: Chemical Guys Furrocious Pet Towel, Blue
2075838.description: Meet Chemical Guys Furrocious Pet Towel —the ultra-plush, super-absorbent microfiber towel designed to dry your pet faster and cozier than ever. It’s great for dogs and cats of all sizes, wrapping them in softness that feels like a warm hug. Whether you're drying off after a muddy adventure, post-bath zoomies, or snowy walks, Furrocious makes cleanup quick and cuddle-worthy. Made from a thick 70/30 microfiber blend, it’s tough on moisture but gentle on fur. Bonus: it doubles as a cozy blanket that smells like you, helping pets stay calm when you’re away.

2103910.name: Canine Canyon Rover Rescue Dog Carry Support Harness, Bright Blue
2103910.description: **Remember to measure your pet for the perfect fit.** Pet parents, get ready for any adventure with the Canine Canyon Rover Rescue Dog Carry Support Harness. Designed to provide ultimate assistance and convenience for both you and your furry friend, this harness is crafted with padded, breathable air mesh for superior comfort and ventilation. Its versatile design allows you to wear it on your front or back, adapting to your needs for ultimate ease and accessibility. With durable buckles and sturdy straps, it's ready for any adventure and offers the reliability you need when conditions get demanding. This multi-purpose rescue harness gives you peace of mind whether you're assisting an older dog, carrying a pup over difficult terrain, or evacuating during emergencies.

2112062.name: Pet Life Unlimited Dry Shampoo Refillable Applicator for Dogs, Blue
2112062.description: Pet parents, say goodbye to the hassle of giving your dog a bath with Pet Life Unlimited Dry Shampoo Refillable Applicator for Dogs! This clever tool is the perfect between-bath solution for your furry friend. No more chasing your pup around the house when it’s time for a bath, as this deep-clean dry shampoo system allows you to freshen up your dog without any mess or fuss. The refillable applicator brush is designed to work with the waterless Dry Shampoo Powder Refills (sold separately), making it easy to clean and deodorize your dog’s coat and skin. The soft and flexible bristles not only remove dirt and loose hair but also provide a gentle massage for your pup. And with its click-close cap, it’s perfect for on-the-go use, whether it’s a trip to the dog park or an overnight stay. Plus, it comes with a starter packet of Dry Shampoo Powder Refill, which has a delightful scent that will leave your dog smelling fresh and clean.

3588422.name: Ruffwear BackTrak Evacuation Kit Dog Harness, Cloudburst Gray, Large
3588422.description: **Remember to measure your pet for the perfect fit.** Be prepared for emergencies with the Ruffwear BackTrak Evacuation Kit Dog Harness. This kit includes a lightweight first-aid muzzle and a human vest with a built-in dog-carrying sling, making it perfect for unexpected situations where your furry friend may need assistance. The first-aid muzzle is adjustable and easy to secure behind your BFF’s ears, while the human vest features adjustable waist, chest, and lightly padded shoulder straps for a comfortable fit. The continuous-support webbing straps help distribute weight, and the color-coded adjustable straps on the dog sling make it easy to attach your dog in either the front or back. Please practice using the kit before your next adventure to ensure success in case of an emergency. Sizing is based on your dog’s girth size, while the human vest measurements are the same for all sizes: The chest strap fits up to 67" (170 cm), and the waist strap fits up to 79" (200 cm).

3598582.name: Non-stop Dogwear Dog Rescue Sling, Orange, Medium
3598582.description: Be prepared for emergencies with the Non-stop Dogwear Dog Rescue Sling. This compact and ultralight sling is an essential tool for carrying injured or unable-to-walk dogs back to safety. Developed in collaboration with the Norwegian Search and Rescue Dog Association, this sling is built to withstand challenging conditions and provide reliable support. Its universal fit allows you to quickly and securely place your furbaby without needing to make adjustments, while the weight distribution minimizes strain for you as the handler. Plus, it comes with a small mesh compression bag for easy packing and carrying on any hike. Don’t leave home without this indispensable addition to your dog’s first aid kit.

3603814.name: Fido Fave 1500W Professional Grooming Pet Hair Blow Dryer for Dogs & Cats
3603814.description: Power through drying with the Fido Fave Dog Hair Dryer. This professional-grade 1500W hair dryer gives you total control with one to nine airflow levels and precise temperature settings from 86°F to 140°F. This handy dryer lets you safely dry short, medium, or long coats with ease. Plus, the built-in ionic switch reduces static for smoother, tangle-free results, while three specialized nozzles (flat, round, and 8-finger) handle broad drying, focused airflow, and fluffing and finishing. Best of all, the low-noise engineering helps keep anxious pups calm during grooming. This handy tool is durable, powerful, and versatile—perfect for pet parents who want salon-quality results at home.

3768774.name: Flying Pig Grooming One High Velocity Dog Grooming Dryer, Yellow/Black Logo
3768774.description: The Flying Pig Grooming One High Velocity Dog Grooming Dryer is the ultimate tool for pet parents looking for a fast and comfortable grooming experience for their furry friend. With a high-performance motor, this dryer delivers a strong yet gentle airflow that quickly dries your dog’s coat without causing any discomfort or stress. Customizable heat and variable speed settings give you complete control over the drying process, allowing you to adjust the temperature and airflow according to your pet’s size, coat type, and sensitivity. Designed with professional-grade performance in mind, its robust motor delivers consistent, high-powered airflow that can withstand daily use. Compact and user-friendly, its lightweight design and easy-to-use controls make grooming a breeze. It also comes with a flexible hose, flat nozzle, round nozzle, and an extra filter for added convenience. Say goodbye to soggy towels and long drying times. With this dog grooming dryer, you’ll enjoy a quicker, more comfortable grooming routine and a happier, healthier-looking pet.

4011390.name: We Love Doodles Professional Grooming Long Pin Dog Bath Brush, Large
4011390.description: Treat your furry companion to a luxurious bath experience with the We Love Doodles Long Pin Dog Bath Brush, designed to make bath time more effective and enjoyable for both pet parents and their beloved pups. This large furbaby shampoo brush features uniquely designed, flexible bristles that work deep into your buddy’s coat to loosen dirt, remove shed hair, and evenly distribute shampoo for a thorough clean. The gentle massaging action stimulates the skin without causing irritation, leaving your dog with a cleaner, healthier, and noticeably shinier coat after every wash. Pamper your barking BFF with the soothing massage feature of this bath brush. The gentle yet effective massaging action not only relaxes your curious companion during bath time but also promotes healthy circulation, leaving them feeling rejuvenated and refreshed after each wash. Plus, the set includes two brushes, giving you a convenient backup or one to share with a fellow pet parent.
